item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure DNS enables DNS-based load balancing through Traffic Manager linked records
item.description:
Azure DNS now supports DNS-based load balancing by linking a DNS record set directly to an Azure Traffic Manager profile. This removes the need to use a CNAME record pointing to Traffic Manager.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Availabile: Automatic zone balance for Virtual Machine Scale Sets
item.description:
Automatic zone balance for Virtual Machine Scale Sets is generally available. It continuously monitors scale sets across availability zones and redistributes VM instances when zonal imbalances are detected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Reader Endpoint for Azure Database for MySQL
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server now has a public preview of a reader endpoint to simplify connection management when using multiple replicas. The endpoint provides automatic load balancing for read-only connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates
